title: Kana
subject: Japanese kana
headline: Read hiragana and katakana, one sound at a time.
description:
Start with hiragana, then learn katakana. Connect each kana with its sound in both directions: read it and recall the sound, or listen and recall the character.

Watch single-kana answers appear stroke by stroke. Practice sound marks, small kana and long vowels through short words, with explanations and comparisons to help you tell similar characters apart. No previous Japanese needed; handwriting is optional.
